name: item-matched-fist-visuals
description: Verify all eight equipped items use the approved sanitized closed-fist mesh, match catalog color/material and icon tier, align the mesh's authored long axis down the forearm, bridge the wrist with a fitted cuff, and stay attached through a punch.

steps.label: wait for character and fist assets

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] c:Invoke('Reset') c:Invoke('SetStats',{Coins=1000000,Power=1000,Depth=75,WallLevel=99}) for _,name in ipairs({'Boxing Glove','Iron Knuckle','Thunder Fist','Titan Gauntlet'}) do local r=c:Invoke('BuyFist',name) assert(r.ok==true,'buy failed '..name..' '..H:JSONEncode(r)) end for _,name in ipairs({'Crimson Vanguard Fist','Stormbreaker Fist','Celestial Titan Fist'}) do local r=c:Invoke('GrantPremiumFist',name) assert(r.ok==true,'grant failed '..name..' '..H:JSONEncode(r)) end return H:JSONEncode({ok=true,equipped=p.RPGStats.EquippedFist.Value})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') local G=require(RS.GameConfig) local B=require(RS.FistVisualBuilder) local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local remote=RS.PunchWallEvents.ActionRequest local results={} local function near(a,b) return math.abs(a.R-b.R)<=1/255 and math.abs(a.G-b.G)<=1/255 and math.abs(a.B-b.B)<=1/255 end for i,def in ipairs(G.AllFists()) do remote:FireServer({action='EquipFist',target=def.name}) local deadline=os.clock()+5 local m repeat task.wait(.05) m=p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild('Equipped Kaiju Gauntlet') until os.clock()>=deadline or (p.RPGStats.EquippedFist.Value==def.name and m and m:GetAttribute('DisplayName')==def.displayName and m:GetAttribute('Tier')==def.tier and m:GetAttribute('ItemVisualReady')==true) task.wait(.45) m=p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild('Equipped Kaiju Gauntlet') local pr=B.GetHeroGauntletPresentation(def) local hand=p.Character and (p.Character:FindFirstChild('RightHand') or p.Character:FindFirstChild('Right Arm')) local imported=m and m:FindFirstChild('Creator Store Fist Visual') local meshPart,meshId,parts,welds,unsafe,anchored,collidable,plates,fins=nil,'',0,0,0,0,0,0,0 if m then for _,d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('BasePart') then parts+=1 if d.Anchored then anchored+=1 end if d.CanCollide or d.CanTouch or d.CanQuery then collidable+=1 end if d.Name:match('^Item '..pr.armorPattern..' Plate %d+$') then plates+=1 end if d.Name:match('^Item '..pr.armorPattern..' Energy Fin %d+$') then fins+=1 end if imported and (d==imported or d:IsDescendantOf(imported)) and d.Name~='Tier Color Shell' and not meshPart then local sm=d:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('SpecialMesh') if d:IsA('MeshPart') and d.MeshId~='' then meshPart=d meshId=d.MeshId elseif sm and sm.MeshId~='' then meshPart=d meshId=sm.MeshId end end elseif d:IsA('WeldConstraint') then welds+=1 elseif d:IsA('LuaSourceContainer') or d:IsA('Tool') or d:IsA('RemoteEvent') or d:IsA('RemoteFunction') or d:IsA('BindableEvent') or d:IsA('BindableFunction') or d:IsA('ClickDetector') or d:IsA('ProximityPrompt') or d:IsA('Sound') or d:IsA('Humanoid') or d:IsA('Animator') or d:IsA('AnimationController') then unsafe+=1 end end end local core=m and m:FindFirstChild('Hero Core Gem',true) local cuff=m and m:FindFirstChild('Tier Wrist Cuff',true) local expectedCore=def.tier>=4 local coreValid=(expectedCore and core and core.Shape==Enum.PartType.Block and core.Size.Z<=0.13) or ((not expectedCore) and core==nil) local minParts=3+pr.plateCount+pr.finCount+(expectedCore and 1 or 0) local axisDot=(meshPart and hand) and meshPart.CFrame.UpVector:Dot(hand.CFrame.UpVector) or 1 local boundsCenter=m and m:GetBoundingBox().Position local localCenter=(boundsCenter and hand) and hand.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(boundsCenter) or Vector3.new(99,99,99) local valid=m and hand and imported and meshPart and meshId~='' and cuff and m:GetAttribute('VisualSystem')=='ItemMatchedClosedFistV3' and m:GetAttribute('VisualSource')=='SanitizedCreatorStoreMesh' and m:GetAttribute('VisualTemplate')=='CreatorStore_ArmoredClosedHeroFist' and m:GetAttribute('ImportedRuntimeSilhouette')==true and m:GetAttribute('SilhouetteFamily')=='ClosedHeroFist' and m:GetAttribute('GripAxis')=='LocalYToDistalForearm' and axisDot<=-0.9 and math.abs(localCenter.X)<=1.1 and localCenter.Y<=0.35 and localCenter.Y>=-1.4 and math.abs(localCenter.Z)<=1.1 and m:GetAttribute('ArmorPattern')==pr.armorPattern and m:GetAttribute('ShopArtVariant')==pr.shopArtKey and m:GetAttribute('ShopArtMatchedTier')==def.tier and m:GetAttribute('ItemColorMatched')==true and m:GetAttribute('ItemMaterialMatched')==true and m:GetAttribute('WristAttachmentBounded')==true and m:GetAttribute('FaceOcclusionSafe')==true and m:GetAttribute('WithinVisualPartBudget')==true and m:GetAttribute('WholeHandHidden')==false and m:GetAttribute('HandTransparencyPreserved')==true and hand.Transparency<1 and near(meshPart.Color,def.color) and meshPart.Material==def.material and plates==pr.plateCount and fins==pr.finCount and coreValid and m:GetAttribute('HasEnergyCore')==expectedCore and m:GetAttribute('HasWristCuff')==true and m:FindFirstChild('Hero Gauntlet Palm Shell',true)==nil and m:FindFirstChild('Hero Knuckle Plate 1',true)==nil and parts>=minParts and parts<=28 and welds>=parts and m:GetAttribute('VisualPartCount')==parts and anchored==0 and collidable==0 and unsafe==0 local row={valid=valid==true,name=def.name,tier=def.tier,style=def.style,template=m and m:GetAttribute('VisualTemplate') or '',gripAxis=m and m:GetAttribute('GripAxis') or '',axisDot=axisDot,localX=localCenter.X,localY=localCenter.Y,localZ=localCenter.Z,colorMatched=meshPart and near(meshPart.Color,def.color) or false,materialMatched=meshPart and meshPart.Material==def.material or false,core=core~=nil,expectedCore=expectedCore,cuff=cuff~=nil,plates=plates,expectedPlates=pr.plateCount,fins=fins,expectedFins=pr.finCount,parts=parts,minParts=minParts,welds=welds,anchored=anchored,collidable=collidable,unsafe=unsafe,mesh=meshId,source=m and m:GetAttribute('VisualSource') or '',system=m and m:GetAttribute('VisualSystem') or ''} assert(valid,'item-matched fist anatomy failed '..H:JSONEncode(row)) results[i]=row end return H:JSONEncode({ok=#results==8,count=#results,results=results})

steps.label: all eight fists match equipped item and wrist anatomy

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') local G=require(RS.GameConfig) local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local remote=RS.PunchWallEvents.ActionRequest local rows={} for i,def in ipairs(G.AllFists()) do remote:FireServer({action='EquipFist',target=def.name}) local deadline=os.clock()+5 local m repeat task.wait(.05) m=p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild('Equipped Kaiju Gauntlet') until os.clock()>=deadline or (p.RPGStats.EquippedFist.Value==def.name and m and m:GetAttribute('Tier')==def.tier and m:GetAttribute('ItemVisualReady')==true) task.wait(.35) m=p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild('Equipped Kaiju Gauntlet') local hand=p.Character and (p.Character:FindFirstChild('RightHand') or p.Character:FindFirstChild('Right Arm')) local emitters,enabled,totalRate,lights,glows=0,0,0,0,0 if m then for _,d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('ParticleEmitter') and d:GetAttribute('FistAuraEffect')==true then emitters+=1 totalRate+=d.Rate if d.Enabled then enabled+=1 end elseif d:IsA('PointLight') and d.Name=='Fist Aura Light' then lights+=1 elseif d:IsA('Highlight') and d.Name=='Hero Fist Tier Glow' then glows+=1 end end end local expectedAura=def.tier>=3 local expectedEmitters=def.tier>=5 and 2 or expectedAura and 1 or 0 local expectedLights=def.tier>=4 and 1 or 0 local expectedClass=def.tier>=6 and 'PremiumHeroic' or def.tier>=5 and 'LegendaryEnergy' or def.tier==4 and 'EpicGlow' or def.tier==3 and 'RareSpark' or 'None' local prominence=m and m:GetAttribute('ProminenceScale') or 0 local size=m and m:GetBoundingBox() local bounds=select(2,m:GetBoundingBox()) local largest=math.max(bounds.X,bounds.Y,bounds.Z) local handLargest=hand and math.max(hand.Size.X,hand.Size.Y,hand.Size.Z) or 99 local valid=m and hand and m:GetAttribute('ProminenceSystem')=='TierHeroVolumeV4' and prominence>=1.18 and prominence<=1.28 and largest>=handLargest*0.78 and m:GetAttribute('AuraEnabled')==expectedAura and m:GetAttribute('AuraEmitterCount')==expectedEmitters and m:GetAttribute('AuraClass')==expectedClass and m:GetAttribute('FistAuraMotionAware')==true and emitters==expectedEmitters and enabled==expectedEmitters and lights==expectedLights and glows==expectedLights and math.abs((m:GetAttribute('AuraTotalRate') or 0)-totalRate)<0.01 and totalRate<=22 local row={valid=valid==true,name=def.name,tier=def.tier,prominence=prominence,largest=largest,handLargest=handLargest,aura=expectedAura,emitters=emitters,enabled=enabled,lights=lights,glows=glows,totalRate=totalRate,class=m and m:GetAttribute('AuraClass') or ''} assert(valid,'tier prominence/aura failed '..H:JSONEncode(row)) rows[i]=row end return H:JSONEncode({ok=#rows==8,count=#rows,rows=rows})

steps.label: fist prominence and aura scale safely across all tiers

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local gui=p.PlayerGui:WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD') local a=gui:WaitForChild('PunchWallClientAutomation') local remote=game.ReplicatedStorage.PunchWallEvents.ActionRequest remote:FireServer({action='EquipFist',target='Celestial Titan Fist'}) local m local deadline=os.clock()+5 repeat task.wait(.05) m=p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild('Equipped Kaiju Gauntlet') until os.clock()>=deadline or (m and m:GetAttribute('Tier')==8 and m:GetAttribute('ItemVisualReady')==true) task.wait(.3) local function enabledCount() local n=0 for _,d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('ParticleEmitter') and d:GetAttribute('FistAuraEffect')==true and d.Enabled then n+=1 end end return n end local fullBefore=enabledCount() a:Invoke('SetSettings',{motion=false,persist=false}) task.wait(.1) local reduced=enabledCount() local suppressed=m:GetAttribute('AuraReducedMotionSuppressed')==true and m:GetAttribute('AuraParticlesEnabled')==false a:Invoke('SetSettings',{motion=true,persist=false}) task.wait(.1) local restored=enabledCount() local valid=fullBefore==2 and reduced==0 and suppressed and restored==2 local result={valid=valid,fullBefore=fullBefore,reduced=reduced,suppressed=suppressed,restored=restored,totalRate=m:GetAttribute('AuraTotalRate') or 0} assert(valid,'aura reduced-motion gate failed '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)

steps.label: reduced motion suppresses and restores fist aura particles

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local ch=p.Character local hand=ch and (ch:FindFirstChild('RightHand') or ch:FindFirstChild('Right Arm')) local gui=p.PlayerGui:WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD') local a=gui:WaitForChild('PunchWallClientAutomation') local punched=a:Invoke('Punch') task.wait(.16) local active=ch and ch:FindFirstChild('Equipped Kaiju Gauntlet') local activeDistance=active and hand and (active:GetBoundingBox().Position-hand.Position).Magnitude or 99 task.wait(.72) local recovered=ch and ch:FindFirstChild('Equipped Kaiju Gauntlet') local recoveryDistance=recovered and hand and (recovered:GetBoundingBox().Position-hand.Position).Magnitude or 99 local valid=punched==true and active~=nil and recovered~=nil and active:GetAttribute('ItemVisualReady')==true and recovered:GetAttribute('VisualSystem')=='ItemMatchedClosedFistV3' and recovered:GetAttribute('GripAxis')=='LocalYToDistalForearm' and activeDistance<3.6 and recoveryDistance<3.6 local result={valid=valid,punched=punched==true,activeDistance=activeDistance,recoveryDistance=recoveryDistance,system=recovered and recovered:GetAttribute('VisualSystem') or '',gripAxis=recovered and recovered:GetAttribute('GripAxis') or ''} assert(valid,'item fist punch attachment failed '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)

steps.label: equipped item fist stays attached through punch and recovery
